5.answer:
We would like to protect you from overspending, so there will be purchase limit for every customer.

The limits depend on two elements:

  • The store determined limits.

  • Your personal spending limit

    • You will get a personal spending limit during your MIS Pay account signup.

    • Further spending limit depends on your shopping history with MIS Pay. The customer's history, determined by factors that include, but are not limited to, how long they have been with MIS PAY and how good they are at paying their bills on time. A good record of accomplishment will allow a customer to make numerous and more substantial purchases.

Due to these reasons, we can't provide a specific number as the limits are calculated by an intricate system that factors multiple points on an individual basis.

Benefits of the "Pay Later" Service:

  • Split customer bills into 5 equal installments.
  • Increase average cart value by up to 25%.
  • Improve checkout completion rates with higher approval rates for customers.

  • Enhance customers' purchasing power through a flexible and easy payment option.

Activate the "Pay Later" service and grow your store today!
emkan.overview:
Emkan, a subsidiary of Al Rajhi Bank, offers the Sharia-compliant "Pay Later" service, which provides a higher number of installments, increasing your sales by up to 25% compared to other service providers. This is achieved by allowing your customers to split their purchases into 5 equal installments at cash price, enhancing their purchasing power and increasing their cart value effortlessly!

Boost your sales and encourage your customers by allowing them to split their bills into 5 installments with the "Pay Later" service from Emkan—a secure payment option for your store.

mispay.details:
Payment Options

MISPay is your growth partner. Always stay on top of your payments by managing customer purchases with MISPay.

Why MISPay is the right choice for you?

  • Our products have been certified as Shariyah compliant by the Shariyah Review Bureau.
  • Give your customers the ultimate flexibility when paying and turn your customers into loyal customers.
  • Give your customers the ability to buy what they love today with a seamless and intuitive shopping experience.
  • You always get paid within the typical payment settlement, your customers pay at a later date. It doesn’t get simpler.
  • We will continually drive new customers to you from our app, website, and other channels.
  • We assume credit and fraud risk, so you can focus on running a successful business.
mispay.overview:
MISpay allows merchants to use buy now and pay later service in their stores. By choosing MISpay, customers can easily split payments — just pay one part of the amount immediately and the rest over the next month.
For more information, please visit our Business Platform
